_comment: Salesforce production-org guard policy. Read by .claude/hooks/guard-protected-orgs.js on every deploy/destructive SF CLI command. Policy set in project-init Gate 2: confirm before any deploy or destructive op against a production org.

_fields.action: 'ask' = pop a confirmation you must approve. 'deny' = hard-block (edit config to run).
_fields.unknownOrgAction: What to do when the target org can't be classified (not authenticated yet, sf CLI unavailable). 'ask' = confirm (safe default). 'allow' = let it through.
_fields.confirmOrgDeleteAlways: true = any 'org delete' asks even for scratch/sandbox, since it's irreversible. Set false to only guard production.
_fields.alwaysProtect: Org aliases or usernames to always confirm, even if auto-detected as sandbox/scratch. Example: ["target-build"].
_fields.neverProtect: Org aliases or usernames to never confirm (escape hatch for a known throwaway scratch org). Wins over every other rule.
